items.item_text: Driver’s License Required.
TIPS California Responsible Beverage Server (RBS) Certification (Preferred)
Serve Safe Food Certificate (Preferred)
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a related area or equivalent experience/training.
1 year of related experience, or 5 years equivalent related experience if no degree.
Proficiency in the use of standard business software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite) and experience using food service, event management, or hospitality
Event Operations & Catering Execution
Provide on-site leadership for the successful execution of full service catered events, including coordination of event timelines, décor, staffing assignments, setup, service, and breakdown.
Oversee food staging, equipment preparation, and vehicle coordination to ensure efficient and accurate event delivery.
Monitor staffing levels and proactively address labor needs to ensure events are adequately staffed and service standards are maintained.
Communicate regularly with Catering Sales staff regarding event details, service requirements, timelines, and client expectations.
Provide operational feedback to the culinary team related to menu execution, service flow, and presentation.
Ensure compliance with all applicable food safety, sanitation, and workplace safety standards as required by Environmental Health & Safety and federal and state regulations.
Maintaining cleanliness and proper storage of delivery service areas and equipment.
Ensuring equipment is cleaned, stored, and handled according to departmental standards.
Coordinating containment, removal, and disposal of waste at event sites.
Evaluate ongoing service needs and outcomes and provide recommendations to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.

Train and guide team members on proper food handling and storage, equipment gathering and loading, vehicle operation, inventory control, sanitation, safety practices, and customer service expectations.
Instruct staff on the attractive and appropriate merchandising and display of food while maintaining required food temperatures and safe food handling practices.
Operate catering vehicles for loading and unloading equipment and supplies for events.
Assist with food presentation and event design, supporting a variety of service styles such as buffet, plated, and other service formats.
In coordination with the Catering Manager, support the management of alcoholic beverage service in compliance with University policies and regulatory requirements.
Ensure proper gathering, transportation, and return of event equipment to minimize damage, loss, and breakage in accordance with departmental procedures.
Communicate clearly with event staff regarding guest counts, service guidelines, and event specific instructions.
Guest Experience & Customer Service Standards
Provide courteous and professional service by anticipating guest needs and responding proactively to service requests within established departmental guidelines, budgets, and program parameters.
Demonstrate effective interpersonal communication with guests to promote a welcoming and responsive service environment.

Utilize clear and respectful verbal communication skills, including active listening, when interacting with guests and team members to support efficient service delivery while maintaining a high standard of hospitality.
Team Leadership & Staff Development

Provide leadership, direction, motivation, and counsel ensuring that campus departmental policies and procedures are administered uniformly and clearly and that work activity conforms to departmental guidelines and the overall mission of the University and Catering.
Establish standards of performance and ensure those standards are maintained uniformly.
Ensure staff is trained on procedures and daily tasks.
Lead staff to strictly adhere to sound fiscal, ethical, accounting, and timekeeping standards.
Implement personnel policies following University and departmental guidelines.
Maintain a positive working relationship with all staff and management.
Summer Conference Operations & Program Support
Support the on-site execution of summer conference programs, including multi-day events, residential conferences, and external group programs hosted on campus.

Coordinate daily food service operations for summer conferences, including meal service, breaks, special events, and program adjustments, ensuring services align with confirmed schedules and service standards.

Serve as a primary on-site point of contact during assigned summer conference events,communicating effectively with conference organizers, UC Merced Hospitality leadership, and operational teams to address service needs and resolve issues in real time.
Monitor service flow and staffing coverage across conference meal periods and events, adjusting assignments as needed to maintain service quality and operational efficiency.
Ensure compliance with food safety, sanitation, and workplace safety standards during extended duration and high volume conference operations.
Support accurate communication of headcounts, schedules, and service expectations to event staff to ensure consistent service delivery throughout the conference program.
Assist with coordination of equipment, supplies, and event spaces associated with summer conference programming, ensuring proper setup, breakdown, and reset of service areas between events.
